description: Zero‑dependency, ultra‑fast Node.js framework that gives you Express‑style simplicity with built‑in type‑safe routing, native HTTP/2, and out‑of‑the‑box edge/serverless support.
npm_trending_strategy: Version 0.0.174‑daily adds native HTTP/2, automatic OpenAPI schema generation, optional TypeScript decorators for declarative middleware, and a single‑file build that runs on Node, Bun, Deno and Cloudflare Workers. By bundling edge‑ready adapters and AI‑ready request validation, it positions itself as the go‑to lightweight alternative for modern serverless and micro‑service architectures, beating Express and Fastify on startup time and bundle size.
download_hooks: Developers choose Yantravese for sub‑millisecond cold‑start times and a <1 KB runtime footprint—perfect for serverless functions and edge workers.
Performance‑first design: native HTTP/2, zero‑dependency core, and optional async‑pipeline middleware give up to 3× faster request throughput vs Express/Fastify.
Developer experience shines with built‑in TypeScript decorators, automatic OpenAPI docs, and a single import that works on Node, Bun, Deno, and Cloudflare Workers—no extra adapters required.
